Package com.im.njams.sdk.utils

Class JmsMessageAccess

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.utils.JmsMessageAccess
  • public final class JmsMessageAccess
extends Object
    Reflective access to the parts of a JMS message the SDK needs outside the namespace-specific JMS code, so that the same code serves javax.jms and jakarta.jms messages. It names no JMS type.

    Internal SDK infrastructure: public only because communication/fragments/ needs cross-package access. Not an extension point; client code must not use it.
